description: OpenShell sandboxes: active sandboxes by connector, phase transitions, egress decisions by source (OpenShell vs the DefenseClaw egress proxy) and outcome, top blocked and allowed hosts, bytes up and down per destination, shadow-AI and other sandbox findings, integration health, and opt-in process starts. Fleet gauges and counters come from Prometheus; per-sandbox detail comes from Loki and follows the Sandbox variable.

panels.title: Active sandboxes
panels.description: Sandboxes provisioning, starting, ready or stopping, from the defenseclaw.sandbox.active gauge (latest value per connector in the last hour, so an idle fleet still reads correctly). Filtered by Connector; the metric carries no sandbox identity.

panels.title: Sandboxes seen
panels.description: Distinct sandboxes that recorded a lifecycle change in the selected range.

panels.title: Egress allowed
panels.description: Allowed egress decisions (OpenShell and the DefenseClaw egress proxy) in the range. One record per decision; the end of a tunnel is counted separately in the bytes panels.

panels.title: Egress blocked
panels.description: Blocked egress decisions in the range, from both sources.

panels.title: Shadow-AI findings
panels.description: sandbox.shadow_ai findings: an AI API the sandbox reached (MEDIUM) or tried to reach (LOW) that is neither its model provider nor its harness vendor. At most one per provider and severity per session.

panels.title: Health degraded
panels.description: OpenShell integration health records with state degraded or failed in the range (includes gateway-wide records that name no sandbox).

panels.title: Active sandboxes by connector
panels.description: The defenseclaw.sandbox.active gauge per harness connector. Sandbox identities are never metric labels; use the Loki panels and the Sandbox variable for a single sandbox.

panels.title: Phase transitions
panels.description: sandbox.lifecycle records by the phase a sandbox entered (creating, provisioning, starting, ready, stopping, stopped, error, deleting, deleted...).

panels.title: Recent lifecycle changes
panels.description: Newest phase changes with the trigger (create, start, stop, delete, watch, reconcile) and the OpenShell condition behind each one.

panels.title: Egress by source and decision (logs)
panels.description: Decisions by who made them (openshell = OpenShell's own network boundary, dc-egress-proxy = the DefenseClaw egress proxy) and the outcome. Follows the Sandbox variable.

targets.expr: sum by (net_source, net_decision) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | defenseclaw_sandbox_name=~"$sandbox" | defenseclaw_event_name=~"egress[.]allowed|egress[.]blocked" | json | __error__="" | body_defenseclaw_network_decision_code!~"SANDBOX_EGRESS_(HARNESS_FETCH|LOOKUP_REFUSED)" | label_format net_source="{{.body_defenseclaw_network_source}}", net_decision="{{.body_defenseclaw_network_decision}}" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Egress by source and decision (metric)
panels.description: The defenseclaw.egress.events counter across all sandboxes, by egress source and decision. Filtered by Connector (the harness connector); the counter has no sandbox label. Counters miss a series' first increment, so the log panel is the exact count.

panels.title: Top blocked hosts
panels.description: Destinations the sandboxes were refused most often. A host the name of which did not canonicalize shows as its target reference (invalid-host, host:_name).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (dest) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | defenseclaw_sandbox_name=~"$sandbox" | defenseclaw_event_name="egress.blocked" | json | __error__="" | body_defenseclaw_network_decision_code!~"SANDBOX_EGRESS_(HARNESS_FETCH|LOOKUP_REFUSED)" | label_format dest="{{if .body_server_address}}{{.body_server_address}}{{else}}{{.body_defenseclaw_network_target_ref}}{{end}}" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top allowed hosts
panels.description: Destinations the sandboxes reached most often (allowed decisions).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (dest) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | defenseclaw_sandbox_name=~"$sandbox" | defenseclaw_event_name="egress.allowed" | json | __error__="" | label_format dest="{{if .body_server_address}}{{.body_server_address}}{{else}}{{.body_defenseclaw_network_target_ref}}{{end}}" [$__range])))

panels.title: Bytes up by destination
panels.description: Bytes the sandboxes sent, summed over the range from log.egress.completed records of the DefenseClaw egress proxy. OpenShell's own connections report no byte counts.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (dest) (sum_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | defenseclaw_sandbox_name=~"$sandbox" | defenseclaw_event_name="egress.completed" | json | __error__="" | label_format dest="{{if .body_server_address}}{{.body_server_address}}{{else}}{{.body_defenseclaw_network_target_ref}}{{end}}" | unwrap body_defenseclaw_network_bytes_up | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Bytes down by destination
panels.description: Bytes the sandboxes received, summed over the range from log.egress.completed records.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (dest) (sum_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | defenseclaw_sandbox_name=~"$sandbox" | defenseclaw_event_name="egress.completed" | json | __error__="" | label_format dest="{{if .body_server_address}}{{.body_server_address}}{{else}}{{.body_defenseclaw_network_target_ref}}{{end}}" | unwrap body_defenseclaw_network_bytes_down | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Bytes up / down over time
panels.description: Total bytes sent and received by completed tunnels and forwarded requests, per interval.

panels.title: Destinations
panels.description: Every destination the selected sandboxes reached or were refused, with decision counts and the bytes moved by completed tunnels. Top 50 per column; a destination with only blocked decisions has no bytes.

targets.expr: topk(50, sum by (dest) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | defenseclaw_sandbox_name=~"$sandbox" | defenseclaw_event_name="egress.allowed" | json | __error__="" | label_format dest="{{if .body_server_address}}{{.body_server_address}}{{else}}{{.body_defenseclaw_network_target_ref}}{{end}}" [$__range])))

topk(50, sum by (dest) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | defenseclaw_sandbox_name=~"$sandbox" | defenseclaw_event_name="egress.blocked" | json | __error__="" | body_defenseclaw_network_decision_code!~"SANDBOX_EGRESS_(HARNESS_FETCH|LOOKUP_REFUSED)" | label_format dest="{{if .body_server_address}}{{.body_server_address}}{{else}}{{.body_defenseclaw_network_target_ref}}{{end}}" [$__range])))

topk(50, sum by (dest) (sum_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | defenseclaw_sandbox_name=~"$sandbox" | defenseclaw_event_name="egress.completed" | json | __error__="" | label_format dest="{{if .body_server_address}}{{.body_server_address}}{{else}}{{.body_defenseclaw_network_target_ref}}{{end}}" | unwrap body_defenseclaw_network_bytes_up | __error__="" [$__range])))

topk(50, sum by (dest) (sum_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | defenseclaw_sandbox_name=~"$sandbox" | defenseclaw_event_name="egress.completed" | json | __error__="" | label_format dest="{{if .body_server_address}}{{.body_server_address}}{{else}}{{.body_defenseclaw_network_target_ref}}{{end}}" | unwrap body_defenseclaw_network_bytes_down | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Recent blocked egress
panels.description: Newest refused connections with who refused them, the stable decision code and the process that made the request (what the process claims, display text the workload chooses).

panels.title: Findings by kind
panels.description: Sandbox findings by kind: ocsf_finding, hook_silence, hook_tamper, large_upload, nested_repo, shadow_ai.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | defenseclaw_sandbox_name=~"$sandbox" | defenseclaw_event_name="finding.observed" | json | __error__="" | body_defenseclaw_finding_category=~"sandbox[.].+" | label_format kind="{{.body_defenseclaw_finding_category}}" [$__range]))

panels.title: Shadow-AI destinations
panels.description: AI APIs that are neither the sandbox's model provider nor its harness vendor, with the severity (MEDIUM reached, LOW refused). The target is the host.

targets.expr: topk(50, sum by (target, severity) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | defenseclaw_sandbox_name=~"$sandbox" | defenseclaw_event_name="finding.observed" |= "sandbox.shadow_ai" | json | __error__="" | body_defenseclaw_finding_category="sandbox.shadow_ai" | label_format target="{{.body_defenseclaw_finding_target_ref}}", severity="{{.body_defenseclaw_security_severity}}" [$__range])))

panels.title: Recent sandbox findings
panels.description: Newest sandbox findings with rule, severity and target. Expand a row for the full post-redaction record.

panels.title: Health degraded / restored
panels.description: OpenShell health transitions. degraded carries a stable error code (for example openshell_egress_auth_failed or openshell_telemetry_failed); restored closes a streak. Gateway-wide records name no sandbox and always show.

panels.title: Recent health transitions
panels.description: Newest degraded and restored records with the error code and summary.

panels.title: Process starts (opt-in: observe.process_tree or sandbox run --process-tree)
Process starts
panels.description: Processes that joined a sandbox's process tree, by how they were seen (sample = the 5 s /proc sample, ocsf = OpenShell's launch record, tetragon = an exec Tetragon reported through the sandbox kernel feed on a Linux docker host). Empty unless the sandbox's process tree is on; it is off in every built-in pack. Without the kernel feed, sampling misses processes that start and end between two samples.

panels.title: Top started programs
panels.description: Most frequently started program names (comm, else the executable path the process claims). Empty unless the process tree is on.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (program) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} | defenseclaw_sandbox_name=~"$sandbox" | defenseclaw_event_name="sandbox.process_tree" | json | __error__="" | body_defenseclaw_sandbox_process_event="start" | label_format program="{{if .body_defenseclaw_sandbox_process_name}}{{.body_defenseclaw_sandbox_process_name}}{{else}}{{.body_defenseclaw_sandbox_process_executable}}{{end}}" [$__range])))

defaults.noValue: No process starts (the process tree is off by default)

list.name: connector
list.label: Connector
list.description: Harness connector of the sandbox. Applies to the metric panels (defenseclaw_sandbox_active, defenseclaw_egress_events_total). Defaults to All.

list.name: sandbox
list.label: Sandbox
list.description: DefenseClaw sandbox name. Applies to the log panels. Populated from the defenseclaw.sandbox.name structured metadata the local collector adds to every record that names a sandbox, so listing sandboxes never parses log bodies. Sandbox identities are never metric labels. Defaults to All.

title: DefenseClaw — Sandboxes
